Initial release of Free Video Highlight Generator.

- Instantly extract and export highlight clips from long videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Upload footage or describe your desired highlights; AI handles auto-extraction in 1–2 minutes.
- No manual scrubbing or professional editing skills required; ideal for streamers, sports creators, and event videographers.
- 100 free credits on signup; authentication uses a simple token system.
- Supports exporting in multiple formats (including MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, GIF, MP3, PNG).
- Automatic backend connection and streamlined session management for a smooth workflow.
